script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LARGE CITY GYM - DAY

COACH JAMES, 50s, stern but kind, paces around the gym floor, monitoring his team's practice. Among them is our PROTAGONIST, JORDAN, a 22-year-old, determined athlete with unyielding ambition.

COACH JAMES
(shouting)
Jordan! Focus on your form!

JORDAN, hands on hips, grits his teeth and nods.

INT. COACH JAMES' OFFICE - LATER

Coach James sits at his desk, going through papers. He looks up as Jordan enters.

COACH JAMES
(smiling)
What can I do for you, Jordan?

JORDAN
I want to be the best.

COACH JAMES
(raising an eyebrow)
Best at what?

JORDAN
Best athlete in the city.

INT. LARGE CITY STADIUM - NIGHT

Jordan trains in the empty stadium, sprinting, jumping, and lifting weights. He's exhausted, but his determination keeps him going.

INT. COACH JAMES' OFFICE - DAY

Coach James looks at Jordan's application to join the city's elite sports program.

COACH JAMES
(sighing)
You're a talented kid, but it's going to be tough.

JORDAN
I'll make it.

INT. LARGE CITY GYM - EVENING

Jordan trains with the other athletes in the program. He pushes himself harder than anyone else, but his efforts are met with skepticism and hostility from some.

INT. COACH JAMES' OFFICE - LATE NIGHT

Coach James looks at Jordan's application once more, then makes a decision. He picks up the phone and dials a number.

COACH JAMES
(into phone)
I want to bring in a new recruit. His name's Jordan.

INT. LARGE CITY GYM - MORNING

Jordan arrives to find a note on the door. He reads it, then enters to find the other athletes and Coach James looking at him.

COACH JAMES
(grinning)
Welcome to the team, Jordan.

JORDAN
(smiling)
I'll make you proud.

INT. LARGE CITY STADIUM - DAY

Jordan trains alongside the other athletes, pushing himself to be the best. He faces challenges and setbacks, but never gives up.

INT. LARGE CITY GYM - EVENING

The team gathers for a meeting. Coach James looks at each of them in turn.

COACH JAMES
(proudly)
You've all worked hard to get here. But now it's time to prove yourselves.

The team looks at each other, determined.

INT. LARGE CITY STADIUM - NIGHT

The team competes in a city-wide sports competition. Jordan faces off against a formidable opponent, but his determination and skill carry him through.

INT. LARGE CITY GYM - MORNING

Jordan stands alone in the gym, looking at his reflection in the mirrored wall. He's exhausted, but his ambition drives him to keep going.

COACH JAMES (offscreen)
(proudly)
You did it, Jordan.

Jordan turns to face the door, a proud smile on his face.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
